top_3_objection_clusters.detail: Fear that an audit requires granting repository access, API keys, or sharing confidential prompt templates.
top_3_objection_clusters.counter_evidence: Black-Box Zero-Access methodology strictly inspects sanitized exit codes and log schemas without code access.

top_3_objection_clusters.detail: Belief that engineers can simply bump recursion_limit or add ad-hoc try/except wrappers.
top_3_objection_clusters.counter_evidence: Bumping limits exacerbates token velocity burn; ad-hoc wrappers miss POSIX signal handling and deadlocks.

top_3_objection_clusters.detail: Reluctance to adopt heavyweight routing proxies or complex infrastructure.
top_3_objection_clusters.counter_evidence: Single-file Python standard library module with 0 pip dependencies and <1ms local overhead.
